instructions.purpose: Save an automation exactly as it was previewed, after the user confirmed that preview's result.

tool.name: automation-save
tool.description: Saves the draft identified by previewId as an active automation, replacing a saved automation with the same name and resetting its failures. Returns the saved summary without source.

usage_rules.rule: Call only when the delegated task says the user confirmed this specific previewId.
Never save a previewId the user has not seen, and never save after making further changes; preview the change and get a new confirmation instead.
Only successful previews have a previewId; a failed preview cannot be saved.

example.context: Delegated task: "The user confirmed preview 42. Save it."
